Players Committee card image of [[I Never Ask For Anything Twice]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “USED: Take First Light or Vos into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Place a character from hand in Used Pile to activate 1 Force (2 if Vos on table). LOST: Once per game, exchange two cards in hand with any one card in Lost Pile. [Immune to Sense.]” Uploaded unchanged.
